# Enheden for Kvalitet I Speciallægepraksis (eKVIS)

Enheden for Kvalitet I Speciallægepraksis (eKVIS) is mentioned once in the corpus as the body representing practicing specialist physicians ("De praktiserende speciallæger") within the Danish quality development program for atrial fibrillation (AFDK) [^src1]. The source document identifies eKVIS specifically as the unit standing in for practicing specialists in this context [^src1]. No further details, relationships, or claims about the organization are available in the corpus.

The mention appears within a document section covering methodological explanations of statistical analysis of quality indicators for atrial fibrillation in Denmark, alongside an overview of comments from the five Danish regions and from practicing specialists — the section explains the use of 95% confidence intervals (95% CI) in assessing indicator values and determining whether a department performs statistically significantly above or below established standards.
